text:
This looks like a square plate of about 24 cm, holding sliced beef, a rice mixture, arugula salad, a piece of tofu or cheese, and cauliflower.

I estimated each component by weight and energy:

| Component | Mass (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Beef, 3 slices | 80 | 150 |
| Rice mixture, including the small pile at the top | 70 | 110 |
| Arugula salad | 60 | 40 |
| Tofu or cheese piece with dressing | 50 | 100 |
| Cauliflower | 100 | 30 |

That gives about 360 g and roughly 430 kcal. I rounded up slightly for visible oil on the salad and the food on the plate.
